description: A tree of floodplain (varzea), terra firme, 10-20 m tall. Trunk used for timber in Ecuador and Peru; bark decoction used as a red dye (vernacular names 'sangre de toro', 'llora sangre'). Not described by a source read. Fruit: globose to subglobose capsule 2.0-3.0 x 1.5-2.0 cm, apex mucronate; aril white-yellow.
